detail.longDescription:
Pocket is the AI personal assistant that lives on the back of your phone. Press once to record any meeting, call, lecture or passing thought, and Pocket turns it into a clean transcript, a structured summary and a list of next steps. No typing, no app juggling, no "what did we agree on?"

CAPTURE WITHOUT THINKING ABOUT IT
• One-press recording on the Pocket device, with sensitive mics that pick up the whole room
• Pause and resume a recording without starting a new one
• Record in-person conversations and Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams calls
• Start and track recordings from Widgets and Live Activities
• Sync over Bluetooth, Wi-Fi or USB-C, even for long recordings

AI SUMMARIES THAT ACTUALLY READ WELL
• Accurate speech-to-text transcription with speaker labels
• Clear summaries with key points, decisions and highlights
• Custom summary templates for sales calls, 1:1s, lectures, interviews, standups and more
• Mind maps that show how a conversation fits together
• Combine several recordings into one summary

TURN TALK INTO FOLLOW-THROUGH
• Action items pulled from every conversation automatically
• Add tasks and follow-ups to your calendar with one tap
• One task list for everything you promised to do

ASK POCKET
Chat with your recordings like you would with a colleague. Ask "What did the client say about pricing?" or "Summarise everything from this week's design reviews" and get answers drawn from your own conversations.

KNOWS WHO SAID WHAT
• Speaker identification and naming across recordings
• Voice Print learns your voice so you're always labelled correctly
• Word Dictionary teaches Pocket your names, brands and jargon

STAY ORGANISED
• Tags, folders and search across your whole library
• Team workspaces to share meetings and folders with colleagues
• Export, merge and bulk-manage recordings
• Works with your other AI tools through the Pocket MCP server and public API

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Pocket is SOC 2 and HIPAA compliant. Your recordings are yours: Pocket never sells or shares your data.

POCKET PRO
Upgrade for unlimited Ask Pocket, recordings up to 4 hours, unlimited custom templates, priority processing and bulk actions. Available monthly or yearly.

WHO IT'S FOR
Founders, sales teams, consultants, doctors, students, creators, and anyone who has ever left a great conversation and forgotten half of it.

Pocket: speak freely, remember everything.
